title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
朱元璋领着儿女们拜完马太公就退到一边，而朱标等人还在悄悄的打量着突然间冒出来的舅舅。这么些年，朱标他们印象中的亲戚只有姑父一家，只有印象越来越淡的堂哥，以及义兄。老娘家的亲戚，那还真没有！马秀英握着马寻的手站了起来，随即觉得不对，“文英呢？”马秀英还是没办法改口，沐英八岁的时候就被朱元璋和马秀英收为养子，让他改回本姓也就是前年的事情。朱标立刻说道，“三哥说他改回本姓了，只能在外头跪拜。”马秀英立刻不高兴的说道，“让他过来给外公磕头！”朱元璋也有些恼火了，“俺养大的孩子，现在还认生了！”马秀英抓着马寻的手，轻声问道，“小弟这些年吃了不少苦吧？”“哪能呢，我这么人高马大，哪像是吃苦的样子。”马寻就笑着说道，“那个，殿下真觉得我是本家？我也没信物。”马秀英立刻就说道，“小弟长相如此，俺还能记错了？父亲名讳，天下人又有几个知晓？”说话间一个昂扬青年走进小庙，直接叩头，“外孙沐英，叩拜外祖父！”马寻低头看过去，这就是沐英了、大名鼎鼎的沐王爷。不过现在的沐英还只是指挥使，封候拜将还早着。“小弟，这就是沐英，俺义子。”马秀英拉着马寻的手说道，“文英，见过你舅舅。”沐英立刻起身上前，但是朱标抢先一步，“外甥朱标，拜见舅舅。”马寻吓了一大跳，这可是大明太子啊，怎么能拜他呢？马寻刚要动，马秀英直接拉着他的胳膊，“标儿是你外甥，你就受着礼。”朱元璋非常欣慰，他的好大儿就是孝顺、方方面面的都无比优秀。礼数等方面的事情自然重要，他可是规定了在正式场合行君臣礼，私下里要行家人礼的。也就是说以后就算朱标当了皇帝，在朝堂是皇帝，私下里该怎么论辈分就怎么论辈分。朱樉、朱棡、朱棣、朱橚以及朱静茹、朱静娴立刻跟着上前跟着跪下。“外甥朱樉（朱棡.）等，拜见舅舅。”这一众儿女之中，现在就只有朱标有正式的身份，那就是皇太子。而朱樉等人，现在只是皇子、皇女，还没有封王、封公主。马寻非常尴尬，非常不习惯这样的大礼，“都起来、都起来，太客气了。”上下摸着荷包、袖笼，攥在手里的也就是几个铜板，见了外甥、外甥女连点见面礼都没有，这就更加尴尬了。看到马寻尴尬、手足无措的样子，朱元璋和马秀英就是心疼，小弟实在是太苦了。

而朱标立刻上前，主动开口，“多谢舅舅赏的礼钱，爹娘一向不给我钱财。一会儿我带着弟弟妹妹们去买果子吃。”马寻尴尬的将几枚铜钱递给朱标，“让你们见笑了，这两个钱买个果子都难。”“舅舅见外了。”朱标就笑着说道，“外甥见了舅舅就欢喜，舅舅身无旁物，仅有的钱财都给了外甥买果子，还不是喜欢外甥！”朱元璋立刻就开心说道，“小弟，你外甥说的多好！礼轻情意重，你就这么点东西都舍得给你外甥，这才是真情意！”马秀英瞪了一眼朱元璋，安慰马寻说道，“俺们现在什么都不缺，你安心就是。”随即马秀英说道，“重八，让标儿留在这，你们先回去歇歇。”“哎。”朱元璋立刻扭头就走，“你们几个，快走！”朱樉几个也都没脾气，从小到大都是这样，父皇的眼里只有大哥。母后稍微好一点，但是重要的场合等等，也只重视大哥。轻轻抚摸着棺椁，马秀英问道，“小弟，这些年你们跑哪去了？”“四处乱跑呗，他好像是从定远逃出来之后才有的我。”马寻就说道，“我该是在浙江那边生的，结果那边乱了，就带着我跑去福建。”马秀英抹着泪问道，“就没听说濠州那边聚义了？”“我隐约记得点，那时候都说郭家败了。”马寻就尴尬的说道，“那都是好久之后的事情了，老头也从未说过这些，只是让我回来。”朱标安静的跪在一边，在默默的烧着纸钱，有些话题他不会参与。马秀英扭头看向马寻问道，“你这些年是如何过的？”马寻就笑着回答，“一人吃饱全家不饿的，怎么都好活。今天抓个鱼、明天打个兔，前些年又是战乱没人管，我走到哪算哪，过的可自在了。”“真要是过的那么自在，怎么就当了和尚？”马秀英直接说道，“和尚都当不明白，听你姐夫说，你也讨过饭？”马寻立刻不乐意的说道，“他就是瞎说，我给人干活换口饭吃，怎么就是讨饭了？我是给人打工，我一壮劳力能去讨饭？”马秀英心疼的看着马寻问道，“不是说你这两年，是前些年。爹走的时候你才十岁吧？十岁的孩子，你怎么熬过来的？”马寻毫不在意的说道，“就这么顺风顺水的过来了呗。殿下，老头停在这里也不是个事。

Zhu Yuanzhang led his children to worship Taigong Ma and then stepped aside, while Zhu Biao and others were still quietly sizing up their uncle who suddenly appeared.Over the years, the only relatives in Zhu Biao's impression were his uncle's family, his cousin and step-brother, whose impression was getting weaker and weaker.There really aren’t any relatives from my mother’s family!Ma Xiuying held Ma Xun's hand and stood up, then she felt something was wrong, "Where's Wenying?" Ma Xiuying still couldn't change her story. When Muying was eight years old, she was adopted as an adopted son by Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying, and they asked him to change his surname back to his birth name, which was what happened the year before last.Zhu Biao immediately said, "The third brother said that he has changed his surname back, so he can only kneel down and worship outside." Ma Xiuying immediately said unhappily, "Let him come over and kowtow to grandpa!" Zhu Yuanzhang was also a little annoyed, "The child I raised is now recognized as a child!" Ma Xiuying grabbed Ma Xun's hand and asked softly, "My little brother has suffered a lot over the years, right?" "How can I? I am such a tall person, how can I look like I am suffering?"Ma Xun said with a smile, "Well, your highness really thinks that I am a member of the family?I don't have any tokens." Ma Xiuying immediately said, "My little brother looks like this.How many people in the world know his father's name?" As he spoke, a high-spirited young man walked into the small temple and kowtowed, "Grandson Muying, please bow to your grandfather!" Ma Xun looked down and saw that this was the famous Prince Mu.However, Mu Ying is still just a commander, and it is still early to become a general."Brother, this is Mu Ying, my adopted son." Ma Xiuying took Ma Xun's hand and said, "Wenying, I have met your uncle." Mu Ying immediately stood up and stepped forward, but Zhu Biao was the first to say, "Nephew Zhu Biao, meet your uncle." Ma Xun was shocked. This was the prince of the Ming Dynasty, how could he worship him?Just as Ma Xun was about to move, Ma Xiuying directly took his arm and said, "Biao'er is your nephew, so you will be honored." Zhu Yuanzhang was very pleased. His great eldest son was filial and excellent in all aspects.Etiquette and other aspects are naturally important. He has stipulated that courtesies should be performed on official occasions, and family etiquette should be performed in private.In other words, even if Zhu Biao becomes the emperor in the future, he will be the emperor in the court, and he will be able to discuss seniority as he wants in private.Zhu Xi, Zhu Fan, Zhu Di, Zhu Xi, Zhu Jingru, and Zhu Jingxian immediately followed and knelt down."Nephew Zhu Fang (Zhu Fan.) and others come to meet my uncle." Among the children, only Zhu Biao now has a formal status, that is, the crown prince.As for Zhu Fang and others, they are only princes and princesses now, and have not yet been crowned kings or princesses.Ma Xun was very embarrassed. He was not used to such a big gift. "Get up, get up, you're so polite." He touched his purse and armholes up and down. He only held a few coins in his hands. He didn't even receive a greeting gift when he met his nephew and niece, which made it even more embarrassing.Seeing Ma Xun's embarrassed and helpless look, Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying felt heartbroken. The younger brother was really suffering.

Zhu Biao immediately stepped forward and spoke proactively, "Thank you uncle for the gift money. My parents never give me money. Later I will take my brothers and sisters to buy some fruits to eat." Ma Xun awkwardly handed a few copper coins to Zhu Biao, "I'll make you laugh, these two coinsIt’s hard to buy a fruit.”“My uncle is here,” Zhu Biao said with a smile. “My nephew is very happy to see his uncle. He has nothing else to do, and all the money he has is given to his nephew.He doesn’t like his nephew!” Zhu Yuanzhang said happily, “LittleBrother, what your nephew said is so good!You are willing to give this little thing to your nephew, this is true love!" Ma Xiuying glared at Zhu Yuanzhang, comforted Ma Xun and said, "We have nothing now, don't worry."Xiuying said, "Chongba, let Biao'er stay here, you go back and have a rest first." "Hey." Zhu Yuanzhang immediately turned around and left, "You guys, leave quickly!" Zhu Chong also had a bad temper. He had been like this since he was a child. His father only had the eldest brother in his eyes.The queen mother is a little better, but on important occasions, she only pays attention to her eldest brother.Gently stroking the coffin, Ma Xiuying asked, "Brother, where have you been running all these years?" "Running around, he seems to have me after he escaped from Dingyuan." Ma Xun said, "I should have been born in Zhejiang, but there was chaos there, so he took me to Fujian." Ma Xiuying wiped her tears and asked, "JustDidn't you hear about the reunion in Haozhou?"I vaguely remember that the Guo family was defeated at that time."Ma Xun said awkwardly, "That happened a long time ago, and the old man never said this. He just asked me to come back."Zhu Biao knelt down quietly, burning paper money in silence, and he would not participate in some topics.Ma Xiuying turned to look at Ma Xun and asked, "How have you lived these years?" Ma Xun replied with a smile, "One person has enough to eat and the whole family is not hungry. It's a good life no matter what. You can catch fish today and hunt rabbits tomorrow. In the past few years, there were wars and no one was around."No matter where I go, I can live a comfortable life.""If you really live so freely, why did you become a monk?" Ma Xiuying said directly, "Monks don't understand.I heard from your brother-in-law that you also begged for food?" Ma Xun immediately asked.She said unhappily, "He is just talking nonsense. I work for people in exchange for food, so why am I begging for food? I work for people. How can I beg for food when I am strong?" Ma Xiuying looked at Ma Xun distressedly and asked, "Didn't you say that you have been doing this for the past two years?, It was a few years ago.You were only ten years old when dad left, how did you survive?" Ma Xun said nonchalantly, "Your Highness, it's not a big deal for the old man to stop here.
